features.name: Lucky
features.description: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die. You must use the new result, even if it is a 1.

features.name: Brave
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

features.name: Ordan Climbing
features.description: You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

features.name: Sure-Footed
features.description: You gain proficiency in Athletics and Acrobatics.
